name: wordinweb-anon-share-demo

scripts.start: node ../../packages/server/dist/cli.js & SERVER_PID=$!; trap 'kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null' EXIT INT TERM; vite

comment: Local run/test harness — not published. `npm start` runs BOTH the collab dev server and the Vite app in one command (Ctrl+C stops both). `npm run server` / `npm run dev` run them separately in two terminals. All deps resolve from the repo-root node_modules.
